# Welcome to the *simulacr* package!

simulacr: simulation of epidemics using contact-driven branching
processes ================

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/thibautjombart/simulacr/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/thibautjombart/simulacr/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

[![Codecov test
coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/thibautjombart/simulacr/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/thibautjombart/simulacr)

This package is under development. Do not use it without contacting the
authors first.

## Installing the package

To install the development version of the package, type:

``` r

pak::pkg_install("thibautjombart/simulacr")
```

Note that this requires the package *pak* to be installed.

# What does it do?

*simulacr* implements outbreak simulation using contact-driven branching
processes. The main features of the package include:

- [`simulate_outbreak()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/simulate_outbreak.md):
  the main function, simulating epidemic spread using inputs on the
  generation time distribution, individual transmission rates, and
  contact matrices; it outputs a `simulacr` object, which is a list
  containing a linelist and a transmission tree, which can be converted
  to `epicontacts` objects for visualisation, and plotted using
  `plot(...)`

- [`simulate_outbreak_step()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/simulate_outbreak_step.md):
  the step-wise version of the simulator, designed for calling from
  other packages

- [`make_pmf_delay()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/make_pmf_delay.md):
  to generate probability mass functions of delays distributions

- [`make_disc_gamma()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/make_disc_gamma.md):
  to build discretised Gamma distributions for delay distributions

- [`make_panmictic_contacts()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/make_panmictic_contacts.md):
  to generate a contact matrix assuming random mixing

- [`draw_labels()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/draw_labels.md):
  wrapper function to generate random alphanumeric labels

\

# Worked example

This brief example illustrates how we can simulate an outbreak.

``` r


## make a generation time distribution
gen_time <- make_pmf_delay(make_disc_gamma(10, 7))
plot(
  gen_time(0:30), type = "h", lend = 2, lwd = 10, 
  main = "Generation time distribution", 
  xlab = "Delay from primary to secondary infection (days)", 
  ylab = "p(delay)"
)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-2-1.png)

``` r


## simulate an outbreak using random mixing 
## (no contacts matrix provided -> all individuals are in contact by default)
set.seed(1)
res <- simulate_outbreak(
  n = 100, # 100 individuals in the population
  duration = 365, # simulate for a year
  w = gen_time, # generation time distribution
  tau = runif(100, 0.01, 0.05) # individual transmission rates, from 0.01 to 0.05
)

names(res)
#> [1] "linelist" "tree"
res
#> $linelist
#> # A tibble: 100 × 3
#>    id     casedef date_infection
#>    <chr>  <chr>            <dbl>
#>  1 eLGzdD case                 1
#>  2 8Tvbyj case                44
#>  3 MQ90i6 case                45
#>  4 RdzUUA case                43
#>  5 kSVCEa case                30
#>  6 Z42dvb case                46
#>  7 YWzVgb case                40
#>  8 EGjSAk case                51
#>  9 6rcYKS case                34
#> 10 VBW4HD case                33
#> # ℹ 90 more rows
#> 
#> $tree
#> # A tibble: 91 × 3
#>    from   to      date
#>    <chr>  <chr>  <dbl>
#>  1 <NA>   eLGzdD     1
#>  2 eLGzdD LjuhEd    14
#>  3 LjuhEd HmhA3k    18
#>  4 LjuhEd J98DE8    23
#>  5 HmhA3k Lwe2aP    23
#>  6 LjuhEd MOZ5Ca    23
#>  7 HmhA3k yKVg67    25
#>  8 J98DE8 knhTUJ    25
#>  9 MOZ5Ca 3eZzb4    25
#> 10 HmhA3k UwrMJp    26
#> # ℹ 81 more rows
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "simulacr" "list"
```

``` r

plot(res)
```

![](https://github.com/thibautjombart/simulacr/raw/main/figures/plot_sim1.png)

Note: for the interactive version of this plot, check the simulacr
[website](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/).

## Getting help online

Bug reports and feature requests should be posted on *github* using the
[*issue*](http://github.com/thibautjombart/simulacr/issues) system.

Contributions are welcome via **pull requests**.

Please note that this project is released with a [Contributor Code of
Conduct](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/CONDUCT.md). By
participating in this project you agree to abide by its terms.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`draw_labels()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/draw_labels.md)
  : Genrate random labels
- [`make_disc_gamma()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/make_disc_gamma.md)
  : Make a discretized gamma distribution
- [`make_panmictic_contacts()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/make_panmictic_contacts.md)
  : Create a panmictic contact matrix
- [`make_pmf_delay()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/make_pmf_delay.md)
  : Create a probability mass function.
- [`make_rng_delay()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/make_rng_delay.md)
  : Turns a delay PMF into a random number generator
- [`process_contacts()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/process_contacts.md)
  : Check/process input of contacts
- [`process_duration()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/process_duration.md)
  : Check/process input of simulation duration
- [`process_n()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/process_n.md)
  : Check/process input of population size
- [`process_tau()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/process_tau.md)
  : Check/process input of transmission rates
- [`as_epicontacts()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/simulacr_methods.md)
  [`as.epicontacts()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/simulacr_methods.md)
  [`plot(`*`<simulacr>`*`)`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/simulacr_methods.md)
  : Basic methods for simulacr objects
- [`simulate_outbreak()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/simulate_outbreak.md)
  : Simulate outbreaks with transmission trees
- [`simulate_outbreak_step()`](https://thibautjombart.github.io/simulacr/reference/simulate_outbreak_step.md)
  : Simulate epidemic spread for one time step
